title: Zak Bagan's The Haunted Museum

services.name: Flashlight Ghost Tour
services.desc: For those who are brave enough to go completely lights out and guide themselves through total darkness in USA Today’s “#1 Most Haunted Destination in America”, our late night Flashlight Ghost Tour experience is the ultimate test of facing your fears! After multiple investigations at The Haunted Museum by Zak and his team on Ghost Adventures, their documented evidence from inside the museum serves as solid proof of what you may encounter in total darkness after hours. Investigate this historic mansion riddled with its own terrifyingly haunted past, while exploring the basement where documented dark rituals took place decades ago.
